interpretationDecisions.decision: The five light-Edge follow-ups begin from standing advantage and are tagged Pressure, not Oki. Knockdown approaches and bomb follow-ups have Oki only where the prerequisite is shown. Corner is used when the selected take actually begins there. No carry goal is inferred from an ender name, and Level-1 use alone is not treated as Cash-out.

Setup prerequisites are separate from performed inputs. Loops may retain the final prerequisite recovery/plant frames to show the timing; they do not require copying the whole prerequisite again. The prior OD cost is separate from the current follow-up cost. Numeric +F captions report remaining advantage, not an invented fixed delay.

Intentional standing/crouching jab, medium and low-kick whiffs are explicitly marked in compact notation. A late midscreen dash/medium miss is excluded. The walk-shimmy after light Bushin specifically begins with the visible preexisting Level-3 buff and zero Super; the unbuffed backdash branch is a different approach. Counter-Hit trades are conditional on the recorded Ryu jab, not ordinary links.

Medium/heavy plants use the actually performed 22MP/22HP. The two-bomb prerequisite uses 22MP+HP.
